title: C++: Database Engine (Simulated)
description: Simulate a simple in-memory database with tables and basic query support.

steps.title: Table with Insert and Select
steps.description: Create a Table class with a name, column names, and a vector of rows (vector<map<string,string>>). Implement insert(map<string,string>) and select(condition function). Create a 'users' table, insert 3 rows, and select age > 18.
hints: struct Table { string name; vector<string> columns; vector<map<string,string>> rows; };
select: return rows matching the predicate function.

verification.failureMessage: Insert records and filter by age > 18
